reuse.why: Introduces one isHoliday matcher and routes all four existing holiday checks through it, though it leaves the 'weekend or holiday' combination (already a local isUnavailable closure) unshared.

duplication.why: The new matching rule exists once; the pre-existing `isWeekend || holiday` expression is still spelled out at four sites rather than consolidated.

placement.why: The matcher lives in shared/schedules.ts next to the other schedule date rules and is imported by the server handler.

scope.why: Only the holiday checks and their tests change.

maintainability.why: A future holiday-format change is a one-function edit, but the non-business-day predicate remains repeated.
